fields.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
fields.note: The formula, negative-CPI rule, June 30 / Sept 1 publication, fair-return petition with 60-day decision, and written notice are all in D085. The 2.87% figure for 2026-27, the $50 per-unit registration-fee pass-through cap, reimbursement of overpayments, and the tenant petition types are not in D085 (they come from D084, which is not provided), so they cannot be verified from this document.
